scaler: Target scale remains2022-2024 labels; extra input statistics use2022-01-01 through2024-12-30 only, excluding the first validation origin.
logging: full train/val/test evaluation every optimizer step
selection: validation MSE only; test monitored, never chooses features or checkpoints
stop_improvement_rule: At least 5% relative validation MSE reduction, three-seed confirmation with at least two seeds improving, and test non-inferiority; report each target separately. Do not stop on a lone smoke result.
stop_other: user interruption, clearly exhausted feature potential or sharply diminishing return on openly reachable data
